title: Pick Your AI contributor leaderboard and contribution showcase
state: Delivery baseline for the dedicated repository and organization Project; app implementation and live service remain planned.

snapshot.scope: Public repository and Project inventory with source history sampling; raw data remains outside this repository.

limitations: Historical public inventory predates publication of this repository and Project.
Refresh visible organization inventory before installing the collector.
Raw exports and full consultation sessions are not republished.

product_positioning.intent: Make each contributor's actual work visible in a public near-live portfolio with many independent ways to be recognized.
audiences: Visitors discovering people and current work
Maintainers recognizing stewardship and checking accuracy
product_positioning.ranking: Independent boards with explicit units, period and source coverage; shared dense ranks; no universal score or inferred employee productivity.
scope_lenses: First observed qualifying contribution with history caveat
product_positioning.recognition_safety: Quantity is activity; labels surviving and issues closing do not establish correctness or acceptance. Bots, coauthors, reviewers and authors retain distinct provenance. No inferred AI/manual authorship.

organization_integration.public_entry: Configured target domain leaderboard.pickyour.ai for local plans and examples; DNS, deployment, hosting, operations and launch acceptance remain unresolved
organization_integration.research_boundary: Research repository supplies public evidence and ownership; its frozen builder contracts remain unchanged. Leaderboard contracts are a separate bounded schema.
organization_integration.website_boundary: Current React/Vite website is static on cPanel; retain it as an independently deployed frontend. The proposed leaderboard server requires separately approved infrastructure.
organization_integration.mobile_boundary: Android/Apple Projects are consumers and contribution scopes. Their 258 Backlog planning items are not shipped applications. No duplicate mobile backend is introduced.
organization_integration.unboarded_work: Include eligible repository activity even without Project membership; .github#2 and website#31/#32/#33 demonstrate why boards alone are incomplete.
organization_integration.existing_authority: Live GitHub Assignees and native relationships remain authoritative. Do not transfer ownership or reparent existing issues to the new program.

architecture.recommendation: TypeScript modular application with React/Vite static frontend, API/webhook service, background workers and PostgreSQL-backed durable inbox/outbox; scale components independently only when measured load warrants it.

modules.apps/web: Public boards, directory, profiles, evidence and live wall; authenticated console lazily separated
modules.apps/service: Read APIs, SSE snapshot notices, webhook receiver and protected mutations
modules.apps/worker: Backfill, enrichment, classification, reconciliation and aggregate projection
modules.packages/contracts: Versioned leaderboard schemas and client types
modules.packages/metrics: Pure definitions, counting, dedupe and policy evaluation
modules.tests/fixtures: Synthetic and sanitized edge-case data; no real emails or secrets

flow: GitHub signed delivery -> durable inbox -> acknowledgment
Worker hydration -> canonical source observations -> identity/context/lineage
Versioned eligibility and evidence receipts -> deterministic metric projections
Atomic public-safe snapshot -> API/cache -> SSE invalidation or ETag polling
Overlapping reconciliation -> discrepancy records -> corrected snapshot
architecture.no_initial_redis_requirement: Use database leases/outbox first; dedicated broker/cache is an ADR if justified.
architecture.live_semantics: Display last published and collected-through times, source health and coverage. Near-live starts from received/observable source facts; public Events feed is not the live source of truth.

proposed_targets.reconciliation: 5-15 minute recent-window scans and daily rotating completeness audits, budget-adaptive
proposed_targets.availability_rto_rpo: Owner/budget decision before launch; no unmeasured promise

architecture.browser_refresh: SSE revision notices with resumable cursor and conditional polling fallback; preserve reading position and only apply reorder on user action unless explicitly enabled.

ui.direction: Editorial contribution ledger: calm dense data, clear typography, teal/slate/amber brand, generous navigation and evidence-first rows. Optional ASCII accent must not obscure data or imply unsupported 3D implementation.
essential_interactions: URL-persisted filters and explicit time bounds
Accepted and pending values visually and arithmetically separate
Shared-rank ties and coverage-aware rank movement
Directory includes attributable observed work, not only high-ranking accepted contributors
Live updates held while reading; visible apply/pause control
Accessible tables, sortable headers and mobile card parity
ui.accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA target; keyboard, screen reader, contrast, zoom/reflow, reduced motion and live announcement testing; source/quality status always in words, not color alone.
ui.ui_acceptance_reference: ui/ui-concept.json and ui/ui-backlog-coverage.json; master uses dense ties and last-30-day default; reviewed source consultation is advice, and corrected master policies take precedence

fairness_and_proof.identity: Stable GitHub IDs, explicit roles; user-account event is not proof of manual work; model trailers are nonhuman assistance metadata.
fairness_and_proof.loc: Separate additions, deletions, churn and net change. Show raw PR-associated volume and eligible code separately; exclude generated/vendor/imports and identify incomplete diffs. Stack/default integration dedupe is required.
fairness_and_proof.triage: Distinct curated objects and observed actions are both visible; deterministic grouping prevents toggle inflation. Qualitative correctness needs reviewed evidence.
fairness_and_proof.research: Accepted research, reproducible measurements, public source evidence and production deployment are different stages. Negative findings and documented unavailable-source checks can be valuable.
fairness_and_proof.time: UTC half-open windows; event/acceptance dates distinct from ingest dates; unknown dates remain unknown; late backfills labeled.
fairness_and_proof.privacy: Public allowlist, minimized records, no email publication or private security content; verified opt-out/correction across all projections and caches.
fairness_and_proof.manual_evidence: Public receipt, contributor consent as appropriate, independent review, role attribution and reversible decisions; no automatic qualitative value from comments, stars or reaction counts.
fairness_and_proof.rank_comparison: Comparable coverage and policy versions required; descriptive ratios have sample/denominator/censoring labels; no bad-contributor list or speed obligation.
